nom: Dr. Brandt Gentle Microdermabrasion Face Exfoliator

segments.oily: The one reviewer who specifically mentions oily skin says she concentrates use on her oily T-zone and rates the product positively overall, though she prefers the scent of a different Dr. Brandt exfoliator.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or flaky skin, including one managing flaking from tretinoin use, report the scrub keeps dry patches away and leaves their skin smooth and hydrated rather than dried out further.
segments.combination: The reviewer with combination skin reports the scrub caused no irritation and left her with softer, brighter skin within two weeks.
segments.sensitive: A large number of reviewers describe their skin as sensitive, extremely sensitive, rosacea-prone or acne-prone and report no irritation or redness when used as directed; one reviewer with semi-sensitive skin says scrubbing too hard did briefly irritate her skin, which resolved once she was gentler.
segments.mature: Two reviewers who identify as mature, one in her late forties, report the exfoliator leaves their skin more hydrated and smoother, with one calling it the best exfoliator she has used for mature skin.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report a visible reduction in fine lines, and some in wrinkles more broadly, typically after a few weeks of twice-weekly use.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers, including some who expected a scrub to be drying, report the opposite: skin feels hydrated, soft and not dried out afterward; one reviewer nonetheless advises following with a heavy moisturizer to protect the skin barrier.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers say the scrub does not leave their skin red afterward, though one reviewer notes her skin felt a little warm and pink right after exfoliating, which she considered normal.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report the scrub helps fade dark spots, acne scars, blotchiness or pigmentation over weeks of use, though one reviewer using it for melasma is doing so alongside laser treatments, making it hard to isolate the scrub's own effect.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin or a history of breakouts report the scrub does not cause new blemishes, and several say it has reduced breakouts, shrunk an enlarged pore from a past blackhead, or faded acne scarring.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin focuses use on her T-zone, and another reports the scrub reduced the oiliness of her skin overall.

aspects.libelle: Recent reformulation seen as less gritty and effective
Cooling, spa-like tingle during and after use
Fine, gentle granules that don't feel harsh
A little goes a long way, tube lasts a while
Citrus scent divisive, some find it overpowering
Tube dispenses a controlled, right-sized amount

extraits.texte: My old bottle was getting close to empty so I ordered another, hoping the different look would still deliver the same product. It's listed as Different Look Same Formula but it is definitely NOT the same formula. While the product is still good, it's not great. It's not what it used to be. It's more creamy than before, less textured from the exfoliators (which is one reason I loved it so much). And even though it's still listed as having menthol as an ingredient, you can't smell or feel it anymore. I loved the smell and slight tingle from the menthol before. All that is gone now. Does the product still work better than most exfoliating products, for sure, but this product is sadly not as great as it used to be.

SensorialityVery very fine particles for exfoliating, in a cream. To me the scent is lemony, and seems to get stronger the longer I massage the product on my skin.EfficiencyI enjoy the sensation of a physical exfoliator, at least once per week. I get oily in my T-zone, so I focus most of my use in this area, though I use this all over my face. I've used a different facial exfoliator from Dr. Brandt that had a light minty scent, which I prefer over this lemony scent.Other appreciated aspectWhile reading the info on the sides of the box, I learned that the exfoliating micro-granules are composed of biodegradable cellulose. I had recently read about other products made from sustainable cellulose, a waste product of another industry. Good to know!My advice of useEven though the exfoliating granules are very fine, I would advise taking care to not rub so hard or so long that you overdo it. It's easier than you might think, especially with the included chemical exfoliant.To whom I recommend itI would recommend this to anyone who enjoys using a gentle scrub that gets the job done.

I have used this one for a while and it's always great for my routine. I noticed a difference after the first use and have been hooked since. It has a thick and gritty texture that easily spreads on the skin. It feels nice as it's applied and is super satisfying to feel it exfoliating. I also love the cooling sensation my skin gets after I start rinsing my face off. So refreshing!It exfoliates really well and makes my skin look so smooth! It helps fade dark spots on my skin and get rid of my breakouts! It has a very light scent to it, so if you're sensitive to fragrances, test it first.I love that I don't need to use a lot of it. Very little goes a long way. Definitely patch test (like you should) before using it all over your face. I have semi sensitive skin and most of my skin was fine and didn't react. Also, go super gentle when you scrub. I rubbed too hard and that irritated my skin some, I got too excited I think. Once I was more careful, it was perfect!I think this would be perfect for anyone with dry skin, especially in the winter. It helped knock out my dry winter skin. I usually have dry patches once the cold weather sets in, but this kept them away. My skin felt soft and smooth! It was brighter and I had a nice natural looking glow when I used it every few days. I also have had less breakouts than I've been having so I really loved that! I use it in the warmer months too, just less frequent. Its perfect for pre makeup prep. extraits.titre: Truly one of the best exfolitors
extraits.texte: This has become my go-to product on a weekly basis. The exfoliator is gentle to use on sensitive acne-prone skin without further irritating it. My skin always feels smoother and more refreshed after application. A small pea size amount is enough for my entire face. I usually apply the product on wet skin so I can properly spread it out and I scrub in small circular motions around my problem areas like around my nose, jawline, and forehead.

I enjoy the Micro Dermabrasion, the scent is a light refreshing lemon-lime. The exfoliant is very mild and has a baking soda type texture that really helps to slough off dead skin, I could around my nose really well. I have combination skin and it didn't cause any irritation. I was left with softer, brighter skin in just 2 weeks.

I love this product! I didn't take very good care of my skin when I was younger and I'm paying for it in my late forties. Using this product twice a week has greatly improved the appearance of my skin. It's more hydrated and looks a lot smoother. The cool refreshing feeling while using it is an added bonus!

I absolutely love this product. It smells great and it leaves my skin refreshed and smooth. I use to have small spots of dry skin but since I started with this Exfoliating face scrub my skin has been smooth and hydrated. LOVE LOVE LOVE this product
